untrustedWorkspaces.description: Syntax highlighting works; the compiler server runs only in trusted workspaces.

tellurLanguage.serverPath.description: Path to a standalone language server started without arguments. Empty starts the bundled vnc lsp.

tellurLanguage.manifestPath.description: Primitive manifest file, absolute or relative to the workspace folder. Empty discovers the nearest manifest.json for each source file.

tellurLanguage.trace.server.description: Trace communication with the Villanelle language server.

tellurLanguage.compilerPath.description: Path to a Villanelle compiler. Empty uses the bundled vnc executable.

tellurLanguage.entryRegion.description: Control to run when building the active file (setting name retained for compatibility).

tellurLanguage.programArguments.description: Native program arguments. Each item is passed as one argument, without shell expansion.

tellurLanguage.releaseBuild.description: Optimize native programs with LLVM at level 2.
